statement: When compensation is required to be included in gross income under IRC § 409A(a)(1)(A), the tax for the year is increased by the sum of (I) interest at the underpayment rate plus 1 percentage point on the underpayments that would have occurred had the deferred compensation been includible when first deferred or, if later, when no longer subject to a substantial risk of forfeiture, and (II) an amount equal to 20 percent of the compensation required to be included (§ 409A(a)(1)(B)).
caveat: The premium interest is computed on hypothetical year-by-year underpayments under the Code's interest rules — a tax computation, not simple arithmetic; state-law additions (e.g. California's) are separate; and whether § 409A applies to a grant at all is the legal question the presumption cards address. Check current codification.
